articles.title: Resurgent U.S.-Iran hostilities send bitcoin lower even as ETF flows show demand
Profit-taking, MidEast hostilities drag crypto lower after bullish week
articles.snippet: Crypto's weekend gains gave way to a Monday selloff as Middle East tensions resurfaced, South Korea's Kospi lost 9.2% and $253 million in leveraged positions were wiped out.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $63,800 as war-driven selloff hits everything but crypto
articles.snippet: Gold, oil, stocks and bonds all moved sharply on the fourth round of U.S. strikes on Iran, but bitcoin is little-changed.

articles.title: Bitcoin is nearing a power law support line Fidelity has tracked since 2015
articles.snippet: The group's Dir. of Global Macro Jurien Timmer calls it an accumulation zone but notes the lack of a catalyst to bounce yet.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether little changed as U.S. launches fresh Iran strikes
articles.snippet: The U.S. hit Iran for the third time this week and Tehran has reportedly closed the Strait of Hormuz again.
